_how: null means pending: the slide shows TBD and a grey 'result pending' mark. Fill a value, run build_endsem_pptx.py again, and the number appears. A slide loses its pending mark when none of its values is null.
_outcome: Slide 20. One of works, mixed, fails, inconclusive, as the registered rules decide. null shows all four alike.
_table871: Slides 7 and 9. After the 871 reruns and the rescore, point paper_compare_json at the new file and set table871_updated to true. The 'to be updated' marks then go away and the 871 budget is read from the new file. The 11-13 file holds the same cells as the 11-12 file.

asp853_full_budget._what: Slide 8, row 'Ours, ASP, full budget'. Per fraction of the budget (10, 50, 100): mean, min and max of F1 x 100 over the new ASP runs; runs is how many. Leave null if the runs are not made.

base_rates._what: Slide 14. Share of stages (0 to 1) in which an unseen region of that type remains, under the frozen truth rule. The 88, 82 and 56% in the pre-registration came from earlier, cruder rules.

room_test._what: Slide 16. Rooms predicted before they were seen, by the paper's rule (at least 2 of 8 members within 2.5 m): hits and rooms counted. Live arms have 8 members. Claude replays have 4: 1-of-4 and 2-of-4, each with the placebo's chance count.

models._what: Slide 17. For each model and level: lift = model rate minus the named comparator's rate (the prior at L1 and L2, the region trade at L3), in percentage points, with its 95% interval; verdict is Supported, Rejected or Inconclusive. mdd is the detectable difference per level in points. wrong_house is the p of the 6-pair wrong-house check at L1 and L2. l1_cannot_decide: true, false or null, as the freeze says.

factorial._what: Slide 18. Spearman rho between ASP's score and the bench's wall-aware cone count, per arm, with the 95% wild-cluster-bootstrap interval of the mean over 24 runs. F0 also gives the share of stages where the gain is zero for every view.

validity._what: Backup slide. Per model: removed_share of guesses (0 to 1); L3 hit rate (0 to 1) of kept and of removed guesses; Brier score of support against truth; yield at tau 1.0 = hits kept / guesses kept.
